analytics.title: Most used models
analytics.description: Reported usage from retained observations. Descriptive rankings within available coverage.
analytics.calendar: Calendar days in {{zone}}: today; today and the previous 6 or 29 days. Custom includes both dates. Queries use UTC instants from local midnight to the following midnight, with an exclusive upper bound. All history has no time limits.
analytics.identifiers: Agent and model filters accept exact observed identifiers, not names or inferred aliases. Available adapter options describe implemented observation only.
analytics.invalidCustom: Choose valid start and end dates, with the start on or before the end. No request is sent for an invalid interval.
analytics.incomplete: Incomplete coverage · Source coverage is unverified. Missing or retained-out evidence and intervals crossing period boundaries can exclude usage. These rankings are not complete history.
analytics.capacity: This query exceeds local analytics capacity. Filter by workspace, agent or adapter, then retry. A shorter period can still require the same retained history; model filters do not reduce the evidence budget.
analytics.busy: Another local analytics query is running. Retry when it finishes.
analytics.timeout: This analytics query exceeded its time budget. Filter by workspace, agent or adapter, then retry.
analytics.workerUnavailable: Local analytics is unavailable. Retry after the observer is ready; no partial results are shown.
analytics.invalidQuery: The bridge rejected these filters. Check the interval and exact identifiers, then retry.
analytics.error: Could not load model usage. Try Refresh to retry.
analytics.nonAdditive: Observed sessions are not additive across models; one session can appear in multiple rows.
analytics.denominator: Token shares and bars use {{tokens}} reported tokens across all rows of this query, including unidentified models. A model filter narrows this denominator; missing measurements are excluded, never treated as zero.
analytics.empty: No model observations match this query.
analytics.cache: Cached input is a subset of input and is never added again. Unavailable measurements are not zero.
analytics.coverageCounts: {{measured}} of {{sessions}} scoped sessions have canonical usage. {{unidentified}} unidentified contributions.
analytics.coverageScope: Coverage counts and gaps are scoped before the model filter. They are not a completeness percentage.
analytics.basis: Basis: retained canonical cumulative snapshot deltas, fully contained in the half-open interval; current workspace assignment. Observed sessions only. No interpolation or inferred model attribution.
analytics.updated: Last successful response: {{time}}. Refreshes on opening, filter changes and debounced observed events.
analytics.unavailable: Provider, cost, active duration, executions, reasoning tokens, task outcomes and quality are unavailable. Token usage does not establish model quality or value.

artifacts.title: Manual artifact
artifacts.manualNote: You selected one retained assistant/agent message. No automatic Markdown recognition or document completeness is claimed.
artifacts.loadFailed: Unable to load this artifact. No source content was opened.
artifacts.provenanceNote: Project and agent IDs are recorded evidence, not current manual associations or independent worker identity. Source was not rechecked; observation time and independent agent identity were not recorded. The source hash identifies the source record, not a saved document revision.
artifacts.retainedNote: Original here means retained redacted text, which may be incomplete or previously truncated. It is immutable in this panel. Source completeness is not verified. Maximum extraction: 32 KiB UTF-8; larger messages are unavailable.
artifacts.draftNote: Edits affect only this in-memory draft. Closing the artifact, changing session or reloading discards it. Preview supports headings, bullet lists and fenced code; other syntax, HTML, links and images stay literal and inactive.
artifacts.limit: Draft exceeds 32 KiB UTF-8. This edit was rejected; the previous draft remains.
artifacts.copyFailed: Clipboard copy failed or is unavailable. Nothing was confirmed copied.

unavailable.event_not_retained: This event is no longer retained. Content will not be reconstructed from summaries or metrics.
unavailable.identity_mismatch: The selected event identity or source version does not match. Select a retained message again.
unavailable.unsupported_adapter: Artifacts are not available for this adapter.
unavailable.not_artifact_message: This event is not a supported retained assistant/agent message.
unavailable.content_limit: Retained message exceeds 32 KiB UTF-8. Extraction is unavailable; no truncated artifact was created.

artifacts.overwriteMessage: Replace this existing Markdown file? This cannot be undone.
artifacts.saveOpenOriginal: Save original and open in default app…
artifacts.saveOpenDraft: Save draft and open in default app…
artifacts.desktopOnly: Native Markdown saving and opening require the ORQST Desktop client. This browser has no file export controls.
artifacts.saving: Waiting for native destination or replacement confirmation…
artifacts.fileNote: Only the selected retained original or current draft is saved as UTF-8 .md. “Save and open” opens only that newly saved file in the system default application. No source file or saved history can be opened here. Check the draft for sensitive content before exporting.

saveResult.saved_opened: Markdown saved and handed to the system default application; editor display is not verified.
saveResult.saved_open_failed: Markdown was saved, but opening could not be confirmed. No automatic retry.
saveResult.cancelled: Save cancelled. No file was created or changed.
saveResult.failed: Save failed or the destination changed. No file was written. Choose a regular .md file of at most 32 KiB, or a new name.
saveResult.write_failed: Writing or verification failed. The selected file may have been created or partially changed; inspect it before retrying. It was not opened.
